description: This file is a shell script used for generating a test data repository with specified directory depth, width, and number of files per directory. It creates a nested directory structure with many empty files for performance testing, including ballast files. The script uses git commands to initialize and manipulate repository content.

methods.name: fill_index
methods.description: Creates a large list of empty files in the git index to inflate the repository size with the specified directory structure and number of files.
